svg.title: Figure 15 · Expected-return changes propagate into portfolio weights
svg.desc: Risk-free return 2% and covariance held fixed. The horizontal axis changes A’s annual expected simple return by up to ±1.2 percentage points. This is input sensitivity, not evidence that any changed estimate is more accurate.
